meta.title: Azure Cloud Sword Immortal
meta.description: The Azure Cloud Sword Immortal in the bottom-right corner: a white-haired, ink-and-gold sword cultivator who flies his sword, guards the furnace, and still tells you to sleep early. 23 standing poses plus a 24-frame sword dance, 22 talisman skins and 10 switchable sounds; the robe switches between black and white with the theme. Watches your balance and records spend per turn: the ledger splits by session, shows the current month, and reconciles day by day against DSH's own cost ledger; bubbles are editable line by line, the peak/off-peak countdown stays pinned, and the About page carries the community group. Fully local: assets inlined, no tokens spent.
